decision: No refactor needed in this slice. The attachment launcher already owns target range, projectile travel and fuse behavior; the new weapon-specific policy is limited to aim and damage configuration.
testDiffReview: The scenario retains its public input and HP assertion. It does not inspect private projectile state or relax its no-direct-damage expectation.
remainingCoverage: Repair-prevention duration, healing interception and the UI marker remain separate required behavior and are not claimed by this test.
